title: Volume after a tax
hook: Two stated cases: explore the baseline and units behind a volume change.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the baseline and units behind a volume change affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the baseline and units behind a volume change in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
